scope: Screen a newly surfaced DWG/DXF preview implementation and refine the distinction between parser-code independence, shared format-reference lineage, independent expected values, and downstream consumer evidence.

method.kind: Primary-source review of project READMEs, current/historical status documents, source histories, and current local parity-plan entries
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: current peer-lineage, optional comparator, ACAD_TABLE/TABLECONTENT, and fast-versus-composed validation constraints
Existing plan receipts: dwg-rs coverage-denominator reconciliation and LibreDWG ACAD_TABLE/TABLECONTENT route boundaries
method.evidenceRule: A separate parser implementation may reveal implementation divergence without independently resolving ambiguities inherited from the same format reference. Project coverage tables, self-round-trips, renderer output, mutable branch documentation, and peer-generated expected data are not semantic support evidence without exact route, artifact, producer, independently authored expectations, and complete loss diagnostics.

evidence.topic: ft_model is a newly surfaced optional 2D preview-consumer candidate
evidence.observed: The repository describes a self-developed MIT C++20 DWG/DXF parser that produces a SceneGraph, JSON preview data, and 2D Canvas/WebGL rendering. It advertises R2000 through R2018 families. Its project status explicitly calls itself historical/superseded and records incomplete version fixtures, layout/object-link, and annotation semantics; its comparison notes use LibreDWG DWG-to-DXF and ezdxf extraction. The reviewed output route is SceneGraph/JSON/preview, not a DXF/DWG writer or a B-rep/ACIS semantic route.
doesNotEstablish: current release-level or per-family semantic conformance
an independent expected-data source when its comparator workflow uses LibreDWG and ezdxf
DWG/DXF writer validity or preservation of unknown objects/carriers
3D B-rep, ACIS/AcDs, or native CAD application acceptance
evidence.planUse: Keep as an optional composed 2D preview-consumer candidate only. Before any run, pin source/build and audit the current test/input route; use an existing repository sample or locally generated scratch control; compare entity identity, owner disposition, coordinates, units, and diagnostics to a separately authored manifest before rendering metrics. Do not add a routine dependency or per-slice gate.

evidence.topic: dwg-rs has implementation diversity but shares the ODA v5.4.1 specification lineage
evidence.observed: The project identifies itself as pre-alpha 0.1.0-alpha.1, describes container parsing as shipping with per-entity decoder gaps, reports coverage from a 19-file corpus, states that it is built from ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1, and says the crate is not yet published to crates.io. The project describes later DWG write-path stages as planned. Its README has a stale verification percentage that conflicts with its version table, already documented in the existing plan.
doesNotEstablish: a second independent source for ambiguities or TODOs in ODA v5.4.1
semantic parity from aggregate decoded-record percentages
a production-ready complete reader or shipped DWG writer
matching results on this repository's input hashes
evidence.planUse: Classify it as a code-diverse, same-specification-lineage optional structural comparator. Pin exact source, toolchain, corpus/input hashes and raw dispositions before use; never count shared-spec agreement as an independent format witness.

evidence.topic: Current LibreDWG documentation narrows its TABLE/TABLECONTENT comparison value
evidence.observed: The current mutable manual separates stable, unstable, unhandled/undertested, halfway, and no-test-coverage classes. It qualifies TABLE as working only before 2010 and lists TABLECONTENT in the unhandled/undertested class. This is a project-maintained status inventory, not an exact-build runtime result.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of a pinned current LibreDWG binary on a particular AC1021 sample
cell grammar for observed AC1021 types 16 and 92
a local libdxfrw defect or support result
evidence.planUse: Do not use existing LibreDWG JSON output as a TABLECONTENT semantic oracle. Reconsider an AC1021 peer check only if an exact pinned API/output exposes ordered cell type and payload boundaries; otherwise record no independent semantic witness and continue unrelated implementation with unknown types fail-closed.

evidence.topic: Comparator evidence needs orthogonal provenance, not a single independence label
evidence.observed: The surveyed projects vary independently in implementation, normative-reference lineage, test-data origin, expected-value source, consumer/render route, and artifact maturity. A distinct parser may still share ODA wording or use LibreDWG/ezdxf-derived baselines; a renderer adds only consumer evidence for its projected output.
doesNotEstablish: that any surveyed peer currently qualifies unresolved J items
that agreement among readers overrides ODA or producer-authored format evidence
that screenshots or aggregate entity counts prove field-, graph-, or carrier-level preservation
evidence.planUse: Extend the optional comparator record with implementation lineage, format-reference lineage, producer lineage, expected-manifest provenance, parser/consumer/kernel route, and exact artifact/runtime fields. Keep all six J items external and non-promoting.
